defects.description: The swap closures call symlink(), which calls t.Fatal, and run inside the goroutine started by loadWithin (Load -> beforeOpen). t.Fatal/FailNow from a non-test goroutine is not supported; only reached on setup failure, so it does not affect passing runs. beforeOpen is also a mutable package global restored by hand (no t.Cleanup), so a Fatalf timeout leaves it set; harmless today because tests are not parallel.

Refers to `statHandle` as if it were project code; it is a Go standard-library internal (os/stat_windows.go) and does not exist in the prototype tree, which can mislead a future agent searching for it.
New unconditional drain wait of up to 500 ms on r.done after exit adds latency to every existing runTUIEnv caller; bounded and justified for output capture, but not mentioned as a cost.
